title: Jack Text Editor
description: Replace adhoc Jack engagement input with handcrafted code editor (syntax highlighting + autocomplete from Rust jack core via WASM), generic framework editor component, split layout: graph canvas + Jack editor + results table.
summary: Fixed jack play so writer-bodied windows never mirror Jack query text in the engagement command line. Added `createWindowCommandEngagement` helper in framework-playground-core for command-only window engagement. Jack editor window command line now accepts window commands only (run, presets); query text lives exclusively in the WriterCanvas surface. `runJackQuery` reads from writer document state, not command-line input.
